Maul.name: Maul
Maul.description: Caster spends their core action to make a melee attack roll. On hit, the caster inflicts an extra (Spell Rank) d10 as blunt damage in addition to their weapon's base damage.

Adaptation.name: Adaptation
Adaptation.description: Caster morphs their body, taking on new traits. Specifically, the caster can allow themselves to take on any number of Fauna Adaptations - though these do not reduce the damage they take from effects, unless specifically stated. Caster can use this as a part of any other transformation listed in the Fauna group without focus or action cost. These adaptations require HEA to utilize.

Butterfly / Raven I.description: Caster transforms into an Great Butterfly or Great Raven.
Butterfly / Raven I.name: Butterfly / Raven I

Butterfly / Raven II.description: Caster transforms into a Mawfly or Eruraven.
Butterfly / Raven II.name: Butterfly / Raven II

Butterfly / Raven IV.description: Caster transforms into a Soalr Starfly or Roc.
Butterfly / Raven IV.name: Butterfly / Raven IV

Butterfly / Raven V.description: Caster transforms into an Astral Wanderer or Strygarii.
Butterfly / Raven V.name: Butterfly / Raven V

Wolf / Bear I.description: Caster transforms into a Wolf or a Bear.
Wolf / Bear I.name: Wolf / Bear I

Wolf / Bear II.description: Caster transforms into a Great Wolf or Great Bear.
Wolf / Bear II.name: Wolf / Bear II

Wolf / Bear IV.description: Caster transforms into a LeechWolf or EarthenBear.
Wolf / Bear IV.name: Wolf / Bear IV

Wolf / Bear V.description: Caster transforms into a Duskhunter or Elemental Bear.
Wolf / Bear V.name: Wolf / Bear V

Polymorph.name: Polymorph
Polymorph.description: Caster transforms the target into any animal with a tier equal to the caster's current tier minus 2, WIL save to negate. The target adopts all of the animal's attributes, but retains their ability to speak their current language if the animal normally has an INT above 0. This transformation has special rules; when the target is polymorphed their HP and mana is set to that of the animal, they may only use abilities the animal has access to, and upon depleting the HP of the transformed animal the target returns back to their exact state before being polymorphed, save location.

Transformation.name: Transformation
Transformation.description: Caster gains the ability to transform into a unique creature. They choose three 'traits' that any other creature they have access to has and must similarly select a base creature from which they draw their attacks, movespeeds, and general size. They are not granted access to any HP, attribute or armor changes. They may also not choose the trait 'Deadly.'
